g.text: AS5047P + EXTERNAL ABI/HALL -> TMUX1574 -> TIM4 CH1/2/3

g.desc: AS5047P + EXTERNAL ABI/HALL -> TMUX1574 -> TIM4 CH1/2/3

g.text: Default: FEEDBACK_ENABLE_N high disables all outputs; FEEDBACK_SELECT low selects onboard encoder after firmware explicitly enables the mux.

g.desc: Default: FEEDBACK_ENABLE_N high disables all outputs; FEEDBACK_SELECT low selects onboard encoder after firmware explicitly enables the mux.

g.text: MUX channel 4 isolates VBUS_SENSE when unpowered. Enable mux and wait 2 ms before reading VM; disable PWM before disabling mux. J601 pin 6 NC.

g.desc: MUX channel 4 isolates VBUS_SENSE when unpowered. Enable mux and wait 2 ms before reading VM; disable PWM before disabling mux. J601 pin 6 NC.

g.text: D601 pin 5 uses an isolated 100 nF ESD rail; no DC tie to 3V3. External signals: 0-3.3 V only, including when board power is off.

g.desc: D601 pin 5 uses an isolated 100 nF ESD rail; no DC tie to 3V3. External signals: 0-3.3 V only, including when board power is off.
